statement: The abstract is one paragraph within dimension abstract.word-range, with no displayed equations, tables, footnotes or citations, no abbreviations except IEEE, SI, ac and dc, and no keyword phrase repeated excessively.

statement: Define every abbreviation at its first use in the body even if the abstract defined it; none in the title unless unavoidable; keep their number small.
why: IEEE author guide; readers may skip the abstract.

statement: Follow the IEEE common-mistakes list (word-choice vocabulary): "alternatively" not "alternately"; never "essentially" for "approximately"; never "issue" for "problem"; distinguish imply/infer and affect/effect; no period after "et"; no contractions; serial comma.
